headline: Wednesday, November 11 — Veterans Day, sunny 72, Granite onboarding four tasks

sections.lead: Sunny Veterans Day, 72 at the peak, no wind worth naming.
items: Today: sunny, high 72, low 50, 0% rain, light 5 mph east wind (sunrise 6:43, sunset 4:58)
Hour by hour: 8am 56, 10am 60, noon 68, 2pm 71, 3pm 72 (peak), 5pm 69, 8pm 62, 10pm 61, clear all night
Week: Thu partly sunny 68/49, Fri rain 75% 59/50 with gusts to 34 mph, Sat partly sunny 64/50, Sun light rain 50% 61/48, Mon light rain 55% 59/47
Rain season starts Friday: biggest storm in the 10-day window, pack the umbrella before then
sections.body: Three dry days left, then wet and windy off and on through next week.

sections.lead: Energy and focus are back today: the Moon moved through Sagittarius overnight and is now lining up easy with your drive and your words, which is exactly the shape you want for a forms-and-paperwork morning.
items: Plain read: momentum day. Mars-type energy says start first thing, and communication is smooth, so the onboarding forms should go down easy
One caveat stays: Mercury is still retrograde across from your Sun, so read each form twice before you hit submit
The next few days build toward the first quarter Moon on Monday, a natural checkpoint
How to use it: knock out the four Granite tasks in the morning while the energy is with you, then let the holiday be easy

Details: Moon Sagittarius 17.5, waxing crescent (27 deg elongation); Moon trine natal Mars (orb 1.7); Sun trine natal Mercury (orb 2.0); Venus retro conjunct natal Moon (orb 1.6); Neptune retro trine natal Venus (orb 0.6); Pluto sextile natal Moon (orb 1.0); Mercury retro square natal Sun (orb 2.4); Saturn retro trine natal Sun (orb 2.5)

sections.lead: Zero new construction-dispatch leads overnight; the boards came back empty on the pre-dawn pass.
items: Nothing new to review on the Job Hunt tab
The 3pm sweep will take another look

sections.lead: The big news: Granite is fully in onboarding now, and it left you four tasks.
items: Four new tasks sit in Workday, Granite Candidate Home, My Tasks: Edit Licenses, Release Form for Use of Photography, Veteran Status Identification, and Granite App Login Instructions
You already cleared W2 signup, address change, and home contact change yesterday, so you are on a roll
One rejection in from the old lane: Shaw Industries Transportation Supervisor, passed over, moot now with the Granite offer signed
No interview requests in overnight

sections.lead: Election results are in, and Antioch police have two hit-and-runs to investigate.
items: Election: Xavier Becerra won the governor's race; voters rejected Prop 40, the billionaire wealth tax; Aisha Wahab won reelection in the East Bay 14th Congressional District
Antioch police are investigating two separate hit-and-run crashes from Saturday that left two pedestrians with major injuries
Berkeley issued a rabies warning after several bats tested positive; keep the dog's rabies shot current

sections.lead: Holiday, and the calendar is not as empty as the last pass suggested: two health visits plus a show tonight.
items: 9:00 AM: IOP Group Visit, in person at Kaiser Antioch, 3454 Hillcrest Avenue (phone 925-777-6300); bring your membership card and ID, allow time for parking
2:30 PM: Video Visit with Dr. Geraldine Shirzai, Zoom, 30 minutes
8:00 PM: Brand New at Bill Graham Civic Auditorium, San Francisco
Between visits: the four Granite onboarding tasks, 10 to 15 minutes total, all short forms
Routine continues on the holiday: 10am apply run, 3pm construction-dispatch sweep, 5pm site check, 7pm apply run
Nothing on Tony's or the Family calendar for Wednesday
